    16	// StickyCtas (spec §5.4): the single global sticky CTA bar that replaces every
    17	// page-level/floating CTA. Fixed to the bottom, full width, revealed only once the
    18	// page hero has scrolled out of view. Renders on every route except /book-table
    19	// (where the booking form itself is the CTA).

    23	const HERO_FALLBACK_HEIGHT = 480
    24	const REVEAL_OFFSET = 90
    25	
    26	type DeviceType = 'mobile' | 'tablet' | 'desktop' | 'unknown'
    27	
    28	function resolveDeviceType(width: number): DeviceType {
    29	  if (width < 768) return 'mobile'
    30	  if (width < 1024) return 'tablet'
    31	  return 'desktop'
    32	}
    33	
    34	/**
    35	 * Best-effort measurement of the current page hero so the bar can reveal once the
    36	 * hero scrolls past. Prefers the explicit [data-hero] marker (InteriorHero/home
    37	 * hero), falls back to the first <section> in <main>, then a documented constant.
    38	 */
    39	function measureHeroHeight(): number {
    40	  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return HERO_FALLBACK_HEIGHT
    41	  const explicit = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-hero]')
    42	  if (explicit) return explicit.offsetHeight
    43	  const firstSection = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('main section')
    44	  if (firstSection) return firstSection.offsetHeight
    45	  return HERO_FALLBACK_HEIGHT
    46	}
    47	
    48	export function StickyCtas() {
    49	  const pathname = usePathname()
    50	  const isBookTable = pathname?.startsWith('/book-table') ?? false
    51	
    52	  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false)
    53	  const [deviceType, setDeviceType] = useState<DeviceType>('unknown')
    54	  const heroHeightRef = useRef<number>(HERO_FALLBACK_HEIGHT)
    55	  const visibleSinceRef = useRef<number | null>(null)
    56	  const deviceTypeRef = useRef<DeviceType>('unknown')
    57	
    58	  // Flush a "sticky_cta_shown" measurement (seconds the bar was visible) using the
    59	  // existing GTM helper. Called on hide, route change and unmount.
    60	  const flushShown = useCallback(() => {
    61	    if (visibleSinceRef.current === null) return
    62	    const seconds = Math.round((Date.now() - visibleSinceRef.current) / 1000)
    63	    visibleSinceRef.current = null
    64	    if (seconds > 0) {
    65	      trackStickyCtaShown({
    66	        secondsVisible: seconds,
    67	        context: 'global',
    68	        deviceType: deviceTypeRef.current,
    69	        location: 'sticky_bar'
    70	      })
    71	    }
    72	  }, [])
    73	
    74	  // Track device type and (re)measure the hero on resize.
    75	  useEffect(() => {
    76	    if (isBookTable) return
    77	    const handleResize = () => {
    78	      const type = resolveDeviceType(window.innerWidth)
    79	      deviceTypeRef.current = type
    80	      setDeviceType(type)
    81	      heroHeightRef.current = measureHeroHeight()
    82	    }
    83	    handleResize()
    84	    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize)
    85	    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize)
    86	  }, [isBookTable, pathname])
    87	
    88	  // Reveal once the hero has scrolled out (scrollY > heroHeight - 90).
    89	  useEffect(() => {
    90	    if (isBookTable) return
    91	    // Re-measure after mount in case images/fonts changed the hero height.
    92	    heroHeightRef.current = measureHeroHeight()
    93	
    94	    const evaluate = () => {
    95	      const threshold = Math.max(0, heroHeightRef.current - REVEAL_OFFSET)
    96	      setVisible(window.scrollY > threshold)
    97	    }
    98	    evaluate()
    99	    window.addEventListener('scroll', evaluate, { passive: true })
   100	    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', evaluate)
   101	  }, [isBookTable, pathname])
   102	
   103	  // Start/stop the visibility timer and flush on hide.
   104	  useEffect(() => {
   105	    if (visible) {
   106	      if (visibleSinceRef.current === null) visibleSinceRef.current = Date.now()
   107	    } else {
   108	      flushShown()
   109	    }
   110	  }, [visible, flushShown])
   111	
   112	  // Flush on unmount / route change.
   113	  useEffect(() => {
   114	    return () => flushShown()
   115	  }, [pathname, flushShown])

   117	  if (isBookTable) return null
   118

   122	      className="fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0 z-[80] border-t border-line bg-[rgba(255,255,255,0.96)] py-3 pb-[calc(0.75rem+env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))] backdrop-blur transition-transform duration-[var(--dur)] ease-[var(--ease-out)] supports-[backdrop-filter]:backdrop-blur"

+import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'

+
+// StickyCtas (spec §5.4): the single global sticky CTA bar that replaces every
+// page-level/floating CTA. Fixed to the bottom, full width, revealed only once the
+// page hero has scrolled out of view. Renders on every route except /book-table
+// (where the booking form itself is the CTA).
+
+const PHONE_DISPLAY = '01753682707'
+const WHATSAPP_HREF = 'https://wa.me/441753682707'
+const HERO_FALLBACK_HEIGHT = 480
+const REVEAL_OFFSET = 90
+
+type DeviceType = 'mobile' | 'tablet' | 'desktop' | 'unknown'
+
+function resolveDeviceType(width: number): DeviceType {
+  if (width < 768) return 'mobile'
+  if (width < 1024) return 'tablet'
+  return 'desktop'
+}
+
+/**
+ * Best-effort measurement of the current page hero so the bar can reveal once the
+ * hero scrolls past. Prefers the explicit [data-hero] marker (InteriorHero/home
+ * hero), falls back to the first <section> in <main>, then a documented constant.
+ */
+function measureHeroHeight(): number {
+  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return HERO_FALLBACK_HEIGHT
+  const explicit = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-hero]')
+  if (explicit) return explicit.offsetHeight
+  const firstSection = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('main section')
+  if (firstSection) return firstSection.offsetHeight
+  return HERO_FALLBACK_HEIGHT
+}
+
+export function StickyCtas() {
+  const pathname = usePathname()
+  const isBookTable = pathname?.startsWith('/book-table') ?? false
+
+  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false)
+  const [deviceType, setDeviceType] = useState<DeviceType>('unknown')
+  const heroHeightRef = useRef<number>(HERO_FALLBACK_HEIGHT)
+  const visibleSinceRef = useRef<number | null>(null)
+  const deviceTypeRef = useRef<DeviceType>('unknown')
+
+  // Flush a "sticky_cta_shown" measurement (seconds the bar was visible) using the
+  // existing GTM helper. Called on hide, route change and unmount.
+  const flushShown = useCallback(() => {
+    if (visibleSinceRef.current === null) return
+    const seconds = Math.round((Date.now() - visibleSinceRef.current) / 1000)
+    visibleSinceRef.current = null
+    if (seconds > 0) {
+      trackStickyCtaShown({
+        secondsVisible: seconds,
+        context: 'global',
+        deviceType: deviceTypeRef.current,
+        location: 'sticky_bar'
+      })
+    }
+  }, [])
+
+  // Track device type and (re)measure the hero on resize.
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (isBookTable) return
+    const handleResize = () => {
+      const type = resolveDeviceType(window.innerWidth)
+      deviceTypeRef.current = type
+      setDeviceType(type)
+      heroHeightRef.current = measureHeroHeight()
+    }
+    handleResize()
+    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize)
+    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize)
+  }, [isBookTable, pathname])
+
+  // Reveal once the hero has scrolled out (scrollY > heroHeight - 90).
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (isBookTable) return
+    // Re-measure after mount in case images/fonts changed the hero height.
+    heroHeightRef.current = measureHeroHeight()
+

+      const threshold = Math.max(0, heroHeightRef.current - REVEAL_OFFSET)
+      setVisible(window.scrollY > threshold)
+    }
+    evaluate()
+    window.addEventListener('scroll', evaluate, { passive: true })
+    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', evaluate)
+  }, [isBookTable, pathname])
+
+  // Start/stop the visibility timer and flush on hide.
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (visible) {
+      if (visibleSinceRef.current === null) visibleSinceRef.current = Date.now()
+    } else {
+      flushShown()
+    }
+  }, [visible, flushShown])
+
+  // Flush on unmount / route change.
+  useEffect(() => {
+    return () => flushShown()
+  }, [pathname, flushShown])
+
+  if (isBookTable) return null
+

+      aria-hidden={!visible}
+      className="fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0 z-[80] border-t border-line bg-[rgba(255,255,255,0.96)] py-3 pb-[calc(0.75rem+env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))] backdrop-blur transition-transform duration-[var(--dur)] ease-[var(--ease-out)] supports-[backdrop-filter]:backdrop-blur"
+      style={{
+        transform: visible ? 'translateY(0)' : 'translateY(125%)',
+        boxShadow: '0 -6px 24px rgba(26,26,26,0.10)'
+      }}
+      data-testid="sticky-ctas"
+    >
+      <div className="container flex items-center gap-3 lg:justify-end">
+        <Button
+          asChild
+          variant="primary"
+          size="md"
+          className="flex-1 lg:flex-none"
+          tabIndex={visible ? undefined : -1}
+        >
+          <Link
+            href="/book-table"
+            onClick={() => trackTableBookingClick('sticky_global')}
+          >
+            Book a table
+          </Link>
+        </Button>
+
+        <Button
+          asChild
+          variant="outline"
+          size="md"
+          icon={<Utensils className="h-5 w-5" aria-hidden />}
+          tabIndex={visible ? undefined : -1}
+        >
+          <Link href="/food-menu" onClick={() => trackMenuView('food')}>
+            <span className="max-sm:sr-only">View menu</span>
+          </Link>
+        </Button>
+
+        <a
+          href={`tel:${PHONE_DISPLAY}`}
+          aria-label="Call The Anchor"
+          tabIndex={visible ? undefined : -1}
+          onClick={() => trackPhoneCallClick({ phone: PHONE_DISPLAY, source: 'sticky_global' })}
+          className="flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border-2 border-accent text-accent transition-colors hover:bg-accent hover:text-canvas"
+        >
+          <Phone className="h-5 w-5" aria-hidden />
+        </a>
+
+        <a
+          href={WHATSAPP_HREF}
+          target="_blank"
+          rel="noopener noreferrer"
+          aria-label="WhatsApp The Anchor"
+          tabIndex={visible ? undefined : -1}
+          onClick={() => trackWhatsAppClick('sticky_global')}
+          className="flex h-12 w-12 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-anchor-success text-white transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"
+        >
+          <MessageCircle className="h-5 w-5" aria-hidden />
+        </a>
+      </div>
+    </div>
+  )
+}

    32	function buildKitchenSchedule(hours: BusinessHours): string {
    33	  const schedule: Record<string, string> = {}
    34	
    35	  const weekdays: Array<keyof BusinessHours['regularHours']> = ['tuesday', 'wednesday', 'thursday', 'friday']
    36	  const weekdayHours = weekdays
    37	    .map(day => {
    38	      const dayHours = hours.regularHours[day]
    39	      if (!dayHours?.kitchen || !isKitchenOpen(dayHours.kitchen)) return null
    40	      return {
    41	        day,
    42	        opens: formatTime12Hour(dayHours.kitchen.opens),
    43	        closes: formatTime12Hour(dayHours.kitchen.closes)
    44	      }
    45	    })
    46	    .filter(Boolean) as Array<{ day: string; opens: string; closes: string }>
    47	
    48	  if (
    49	    weekdayHours.length === weekdays.length &&
    50	    weekdayHours.every(h => h.opens === weekdayHours[0].opens && h.closes === weekdayHours[0].closes)
    51	  ) {
    52	    schedule['Tuesday to Friday'] = `${weekdayHours[0].opens}-${weekdayHours[0].closes}`
    53	  } else {
    54	    weekdayHours.forEach(h => {
    55	      schedule[h.day.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + h.day.slice(1)] = `${h.opens}-${h.closes}`
    56	    })
    57	  }
    58	
    59	  const saturdayHours = hours.regularHours.saturday?.kitchen
    60	  if (saturdayHours && isKitchenOpen(saturdayHours)) {
    61	    schedule.Saturday = `${formatTime12Hour(saturdayHours.opens)}-${formatTime12Hour(saturdayHours.closes)}`
    62	  }
    63	
    64	  const sundayHours = hours.regularHours.sunday?.kitchen
    65	  if (sundayHours && isKitchenOpen(sundayHours)) {
    66	    schedule.Sunday = `${formatTime12Hour(sundayHours.opens)}-${formatTime12Hour(sundayHours.closes)}`
    67	  }
    68	
    69	  return Object.entries(schedule)
    70	    .map(([day, time]) => `${day} ${time}`)
    71	    .join(', ')
    72	}

app/private-hire/milestone-birthdays/page.tsx:170:                                    A 21st is the first big one worth celebrating properly. Our beer garden works brilliantly for summer 21sts — reserve an area, order a buffet, and let the evening unfold naturally. Strict ID policies apply, but the vibe is relaxed. Most 21sts here run 15&ndash;30 guests with a finger buffet and a bar tab.
app/private-hire/milestone-birthdays/page.tsx:176:                                    Turning 30 deserves more than drinks at a chain bar. Our dining room seats 26 for a sit-down meal, or clear the space for a dance floor with a DJ and a burger buffet. No minimum spend means your budget goes on exactly what you want — food, drinks, and entertainment. Read our <Link href="/blog/30th-birthday-party-ideas-venues" className="text-accent-text hover:underline font-semibold">30th birthday party ideas</Link> for inspiration.
app/private-hire/milestone-birthdays/page.tsx:182:                                    The big four-oh is when parties get good — people know what they like, and the crowd is always up for it. Most 40th birthday parties here are 30&ndash;50 guests with a premium buffet, welcome drinks, and a DJ. Free parking means nobody needs a designated driver. See our <Link href="/blog/40th-birthday-party-ideas-venues" className="text-accent-text hover:underline font-semibold">40th birthday party ideas</Link> guide.
app/private-hire/milestone-birthdays/page.tsx:194:                                    60th, 70th, and 80th birthdays tend to be more intimate — a long table, a great meal, and the people who matter most. We can set a private dining area for 10&ndash;20 guests with a set menu or à la carte service. The atmosphere is warm without being fussy, and there&apos;s no pressure to rush. See our <Link href="/blog/60th-birthday-party-ideas-venues" className="text-accent-text hover:underline font-semibold">60th birthday party ideas</Link>.

app/pool-darts-pub/page.tsx:57:                            Whether you&apos;re killing time before a flight, settling a long-running grudge match with a mate, or just fancy a frame and a pint on a Tuesday evening — this is a pub where the games are taken seriously and the beer is cold. app/pool-darts-pub/page.tsx:91:                                        A dartboard with a proper throw area — not a battered board crammed behind a fruit machine. We&apos;re upgrading to a professional-grade board with electronic scorer and better lighting in 2026.
app/pool-darts-pub/page.tsx:116:                                The Anchor isn&apos;t a pool hall — it&apos;s a pub that happens to have genuinely good games facilities. That means you get the full pub experience alongside your game: proper beer on tap, food from the kitchen (Tuesday to Sunday), and a beer garden with planes landing overhead every ninety seconds if you fancy watching the show between frames.
app/pool-darts-pub/page.tsx:119:                                Most people who come to play pool or throw darts end up staying longer than they planned. That&apos;s not an accident — it&apos;s what happens when you combine decent equipment with a relaxed atmosphere and no pressure to rush.
